basis: ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.md confirmed findings x T0 per-topic GFS breakdown (baseline GFS 99.10, defect 0.90 pts: 19/2347 accept fails, 23/2058 reject fails)

hypotheses.title: Normalize ASCII <= / >= in expression grading (review H1)
hypotheses.claim: Mapping '<=' to '≤' and '>=' to '≥' inside validateAnswer's normalizeExpr makes every keyboard-typeable inequality answer gradeable, eliminating all 19 measured accept-failures (topic 'inequalities', label expr-ascii-ineq).
hypotheses.evidence: Review H1: 60/60 generated ≤/≥ problems rejected 'x <= 4'. T0: inequalities GFS 86.57, all fails expr-ascii-ineq.
hypotheses.risk: low - normalization is additive; reject probes (wrong direction) unaffected because direction still differs after mapping

hypotheses.title: Scope decimal tolerance to stated precision (review M10 + surface-area overshoot)
hypotheses.claim: Exact-integer circle 'diameter' answers graded as numeric (not ±0.5 tolerance), and integration-applications 'surface-area' tolerance tightened from 0.5 to 0.05 (pi-precision spread at a≤4 is ~0.036; stated rounding is 2dp), eliminates all 23 measured reject-failures.
hypotheses.evidence: Review M10: 19.6 graded correct for diameter 20. T0: circles GFS 85.75 (19 dec-wrong-nearmiss rejects), integration-applications 97.0 (4).
hypotheses.risk: low-medium - must not break pi-based problems where 0.5 tolerance is legitimate (students using pi vs 3.14); change only the diameter branch and the surface-area subtype

hypotheses.title: Combined: ASCII inequality normalization + tolerance scoping
hypotheses.claim: The union of exp-a and exp-b removes every measured defect (expected GFS ~100). Run as a separate experiment to verify the two fixes compose without interaction effects.
hypotheses.evidence: Fix domains are disjoint (expression grading vs decimal-tolerance problem generation).
hypotheses.risk: low - union of two low-risk diffs; if an interaction appears, exp-a or exp-b can still win alone

rejected_hypotheses.title: Relative-tolerance spot check in expressionsAlgebraicallyEqual (review M9) + parseable canonical forms (M8)
rejected_hypotheses.reason: Real defects, but not measured by the current probe corpus at baseline - cannot pass gate G3 (>=25% measured-defect reduction). Recorded for a future round with richer probes.

rejected_hypotheses.title: Timer double-fail (H3), localStorage bricking (H4), UI findings
rejected_hypotheses.reason: Outside the GFS objective (component behavior, not grading fidelity). Listed in the final report as recommended follow-ups, not overnight-mergeable.
